visual_style: Premium stylized cinematic 3D animation. Appealing expressive characters, clean silhouettes, recognizable facial geometry, believable environments, controlled detail, strong visual consistency and family-animation quality. Not photorealistic and not flat preschool cartoon.
color_language: Warm natural palette with controlled character-specific accent colors. Environments remain believable and readable. Mystery scenes may introduce cooler contrast without changing the canonical world palette.
camera_language: Story-driven cinematography using establishing shots, medium shots, close-ups and reaction shots. Camera movement must have narrative purpose. Avoid constant movement and random dramatic angles.
texture_language: Clean stylized materials with moderate tactile detail. Skin, hair, fabric, wood, metal and environmental surfaces must remain visually distinct without photorealistic micro-detail.
lighting_language: Soft cinematic lighting with motivated practical and environmental light. Daylight remains warm and natural. Mystery moments use controlled contrast and atmosphere without becoming horror.
animation_language: Expressive but controlled performance. Clear posing, readable facial acting, natural body mechanics and strong eye direction. Avoid exaggerated preschool motion unless intentionally used for comedy.
